project_info.theme: Texture claim explainer for YSL lipstick

main_subject.style: Luxury beauty claim poster, clean product education visual, texture-focused cosmetic infographic

composition_elements.text: KẾT CẤU “MATTE HYBRID” ĐỘC BẢN, MỎNG NHẸ TỰ NHIÊN, HIỆU ỨNG MỜ LÌ MANG ĐẾN CẢM GIÁC MỀM MỊN NHƯ MỘT THỎI SON DƯỠNG

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square beauty claim poster for YSL. Centerpiece is a pale pink YSL lipstick standing vertically on the right side over a dusty rose textured background with a clear hard shadow. Include the exact text 'KẾT CẤU “MATTE HYBRID” ĐỘC BẢN' and 'MỎNG NHẸ TỰ NHIÊN, HIỆU ỨNG MỜ LÌ MANG ĐẾN CẢM GIÁC MỀM MỊN NHƯ MỘT THỎI SON DƯỠNG' in white on the left, plus the vertical YSL logo on the upper right. Technical style: photoreal beauty infographic composite, bright clean studio lighting, crisp metallic reflections and tactile texture, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
